cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.noAccountsHint: Each account gets its own Cursor profile: add it, sign in, then click "Finish Init"
cursor.working: Working — may take up to a minute, do not force-quit…
cursor.switchTip: "Switch" closes Cursor and reopens the target account. Workspace and settings are shared; only sign-in is per account. Save your files first.
cursor.setupStep1: Click "Add Account" and sign in to the first account in the isolated Cursor window
cursor.setupStep2: Back here, click "Finish Init" until it shows "Isolated sign-in · shared workspace"
cursor.setupStep3: Add a second account (the first is backed up and closed — its sign-in is kept)
cursor.setupStep4: Sign in inside the second account's isolated Cursor, then click "Finish Init"
cursor.setupStep5: Once both are ready, use "Switch"; only one Cursor runs at a time
cursor.needsInitHint: Sign in inside the isolated Cursor, then click "Finish Init"
cursor.quitMessage: All Cursor windows will be closed. Save your unsaved files first.
cursor.orphanCleanupMessage: Deletes {{count}} profile directories no account references (~{{size}}).
cursor.orphanCleanupWarning: Only unreferenced profile directories are removed; the shared workspace and default Cursor data are untouched.
cursor.launchHint: Signed-in account — click to start Cursor
cursor.reopenHint: After Cursor was closed, reopen this account's isolated profile window
cursor.reopenOk: Cursor reopened — sign in to the account in its window
cursor.noProfileDir: This account has no isolated profile directory yet
cursor.deleteWarning: Permanently removes this account's backup and profile directory. Shared workspace data is kept.
cursor.usageLead: Multi-account switching · shared workspace & sessions · isolated sign-in
cursor.usage1: 1. Click "Add Account" → sign in in the isolated Cursor → "Finish Init"
cursor.usage2: 2. Add further accounts after the first is done; closing Cursor does not invalidate finished accounts
cursor.usage3: 3. Workspace, recent projects, local history, settings and extensions are shared across accounts
cursor.usage4: 4. Use "Switch" day to day; Cursor closes briefly during a switch (expected)
cursor.usage5: 5. Switch failed / Authentication error → run "Finish Init" for that account again
cursor.usage6: 6. Link a Git identity to also switch git user.name / user.email
cursor.linkGitPlaceholder: Fill from an existing Git account…
cursor.addConfirmMessage:
The current account's login is saved, Cursor is closed, and the new account's isolated profile opens.
Sign in inside Cursor, then come back and click "Finish Init".
cursor.addConfirmWarning: Closing Cursor does not invalidate finished accounts — each login lives in its own profile. Save unsaved files first. Setup can take tens of seconds; do not force-quit the workbench.
cursor.finishInitMessage:
Saves the login for "{{name}}" into its isolated profile.
Make sure you signed in inside that account's isolated Cursor window (not the default one you opened manually).
cursor.finishInitWarning: Can take tens of seconds (closing Cursor / writing the profile). Do not force-quit the workbench while progress is updating.
cursor.finishInitOk: Setup complete — you can switch now
cursor.cursorDetectFailed: Could not detect whether Cursor is running
cursor.notInitialized: This account is not set up yet — click "Finish Init" first
cursor.snapshotBlocked: Snapshot for "{{name}}" unavailable: {{reason}}. Sign in again and click "Finish Init".
cursor.pendingInitBlocked: Finish setting up "{{name}}" (complete snapshot) before adding another account. Closing Cursor does not invalidate finished accounts.
cursor.switchActionRunning: Cursor will close, the login switches, and Cursor reopens.
cursor.switchActionIdle: The login switches and Cursor opens.
cursor.switchWarningUnsaved: The current login is not saved as an account and will be lost on switch. Add it and finish init first. Unsaved files will be lost too.
cursor.switchWarning: Save your unsaved files in Cursor first — switching closes Cursor.
cursor.diskBackupsClean: No stale full DBs — already lightweight
cursor.cleanupMessage:
Delete leftover full DB copies in backups and any mistaken login DB under the shared layer (~{{size}} / {{count}} related).
Keeps per-account auth.json and Cookies.
cursor.cleanupWarning: Does not touch the default Cursor live DB or per-account profile login DBs.
cursor.passwordMemoNote: Local memo only — does not auto-login Cursor. Handy when signing in manually next time.
cursor.passwordHint: You can save a login password memo per account (local only). Sign-in still happens inside Cursor.
